name: USB Moon & Earth Projection Atmosphere Light | 3 Interchangeable Lenses | Flexible Gooseneck  Projector Lamp
description:
Transform your room into a dreamy and relaxing space with this USB Moon & Earth Projection Atmosphere Light. Featuring 3 interchangeable lenses, this compact projector creates beautiful moon, earth, and starry sky effects on walls and ceilings. Its flexible 360° gooseneck allows you to easily adjust the projection angle, making it perfect for bedrooms, children's rooms, gaming setups, romantic décor, and creative ambient lighting.

Key Features
Includes 3 interchangeable lenses for different projection effects
Projects moon, earth, and sun visuals onto walls and ceilings
360° flexible gooseneck for easy angle adjustment
Creates a romantic, relaxing, and dreamy atmosphere
USB-powered design for convenient plug-and-play use
Compatible with laptops, power banks, USB adapters, and other USB power sources
Compact and lightweight design for easy placement
Energy-efficient ambient lighting solution
Suitable for bedrooms, children's rooms, living rooms, and gaming setups
Ideal for romantic décor, photography backgrounds, and creative room decoration

Product Specifications
Product Type: Moon & Earth Projection Atmosphere Light
Power Source: USB
Projection Themes: Moon, Earth, and Sun
Number of Lenses: 3 Interchangeable Lenses
Neck Design: Flexible 360° Gooseneck
Usage: Indoor Ambient and Decorative Lighting
Suitable For: Bedroom, Living Room, Children's Room, Gaming Setup, and Décor

How to Use
Connect the projector to a suitable USB power source
Select and install your preferred projection lens
Adjust the flexible gooseneck toward the desired wall or ceiling
Position the projector to achieve the preferred projection size and angle
Change the lens anytime to enjoy different visual effects

Material / Composition
Durable Plastic Body
LED Light Components
Flexible Gooseneck
Interchangeable Projection Lenses

Safety Information
For indoor use only
Keep away from water and moisture
Do not look directly into the light source
Keep out of reach of small children
Disconnect from power when not in use
Store in a cool and dry place

Package Includes
1 × USB Moon & Earth Projection Light
3 × Interchangeable Projection Lenses
